name: QA shift procedure trap: the documented per-card gate command (`paths=["<file>"]`) returns a false `allow` — always use the `docs/` prefix or whole-tree scope until `6c697929` lands
description:
Written by qa shift #9 (2026-11-19T16:3xZ) so the defect does not silently corrupt the next verdict.

## What was measured (clean A/B, one file, same tree)

| call | result |
| --- | --- |
| `project_changes(scope="all", paths=[".vitepress/config.mts"])` | 1 file, +7/-0 |
| `qa_review_changes(scope="all", paths=[".vitepress/config.mts"])` | **allow**, changed_files 0, findings 0 |
| `qa_review_changes(scope="all", paths=["docs/.vitepress/config.mts"])` | **block**, changed_files 1, `tests.no-suite` (high) |

Cause: the QA gate root is the platform root; the project root is `docs/`. An unprefixed path matches nothing and the gate reports the empty diff as `allow`.

## Why this card exists

My standing order literally says *"run `qa_review_changes` on the card's diff"*. Executed literally, that command returns a false green on every docs file. This card is the reminder to (a) always prefix `docs/` or run whole-tree scope, and (b) treat `changed_files 0 → allow` as **no verdict**, never as a pass.

## Acceptance criteria

- Every QA verdict comment on the `IT team` board quotes the probe form it used (prefixed path or whole-tree scope).
- No verdict of `allow` is ever posted from a call whose `changed_files` is 0 while `project_changes` lists changes on the same path.
- Closed when `6c697929` lands the real fix (`path.not-found` / `nothing_to_review` instead of `allow`) — then re-measure the A/B above and quote the new result here.

## Constraint

Do not amend `qa_policy` or the standing orders from a QA shift; the procedural ask belongs to the user (`e684ce5c`, `3fb379ae`).
